game.name: Football Manager 2008 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Football Manager 2008 is a management game that puts you in the shoes of a coach. It offers the opportunity to practice this profession in one of the leagues of 50 different countries and, for the first time, benefits from the real licences for Ligue 1 and Ligue 2 in France. This Xbox 360 version also allows up to 16 players to compete on the same machine and up to 8 users to participate in seasons and tournaments on Xbox Live.
